messages:
maya: Quick draft for internal RN: rolling out 'smart-batch v2' tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need pinning + rollback thumbs. Deploy window 09:00-10:00 PT.

dev-deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued job dpl-5007 for 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z. React :rocket: to lock canary.

sam: Paste the pin matrix and one-line customer impact?

maya: Pin matrix snippet: us-east: v2.0.0 (canary 5% 30m -> 25% -> 100%), eu-west: v1.9.8 (canary 2% 60m -> 10% -> 50%). Fallback: v1.9.5. Watch p95>210ms or error_rate>1.2%.

lina: Note: EU dedicated tenants stay on v1.9.8 unless CS approves opt-in. Add KV cache warmup=15m.

ops-oncall: Rollback plan: 1) pause dpl-5007 2) route traffic to v1.9.5 3) run sanity probes for 10m 4) open #incident-dpl-5007 and update RN. I'll post the short checklist in the thread.

sam: Draft internal blurb ready to post at T-15m. I'll push RN to /docs/internal/releases/2026-03-24-smart-batch-v2.md and pin.

maya: :thumbsup: merging RN in 15m if no objections.

ops-oncall: checklist posted.
